    orders=('Order ID', 'count')
).sort_index()

# Order Status if exists

    print(f"QUANTITY SUMMARY (column: {qty_col})")

cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object','category']).columns.tolist()

cat_cols = [c for c in cat_cols if not any(k in c.lower() for k in ['id','date','time'])]

for cc in cat_cols:

    if 1 < nunique <= 30:

        print(f"BREAKDOWN BY {cc.upper()} ({nunique} categories)")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        if rev_col:
            grp = df.groupby(cc).agg(
                total_revenue=(rev_col, 'sum'),
                order_count=(rev_col, 'count'),
                avg_order=(rev_col, 'mean')
            ).sort_values('total_revenue', ascending=False)
            if qty_col:
                grp['total_qty'] = df.groupby(cc)[qty_col].sum()
            for name, row in grp.iterrows():
                line = f"  {name}: ${row['total_revenue']:,.2f} ({int(row['order_count'])} orders, avg ${row['avg_order']:,.2f})"
                if qty_col and 'total_qty' in row:
                    line += f", {int(row['total_qty'])} units"
                print(line)
        else:
            print(df[cc].value_counts().to_string())

# Monthly trend

    print(f"\\n{'='*60}")
    print("MONTHLY TREND")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    df['_month'] = df[dc].dt.to_period('M')
    monthly = df.groupby('_month').agg(
        revenue=(rev_col, 'sum'),
        orders=(rev_col, 'count')
    ).sort_index()
    if qty_col:
        monthly['units'] = df.groupby('_month')[qty_col].sum()
    for m, row in monthly.iterrows():
        line = f"  {m}: ${row['revenue']:,.2f} ({int(row['orders'])} orders)"
        if qty_col:
            line += f", {int(row['units'])} units"
        print(line)

cust_candidates = [c for c in cat_cols if any(k in c.lower() for k in ['customer','client','buyer','name'])]
if cust_candidates and rev_col:
    cust_col = cust_candidates[0]
    print(f"\\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"TOP 5 CUSTOMERS BY REVENUE ({cust_col})")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    top5 = df.groupby(cust_col)[rev_col].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(5)
    for name, val in top5.items():
        pct = val / df[rev_col].sum() * 100
        print(f"  {name}: ${val:,.2f} ({pct:.1f}% of total)")

# Unit price if both rev and qty exist
if rev_col and qty_col:
    prod_candidates = [c for c in cat_cols if any(k in c.lower() for k in ['product','item','sku'])]
    if prod_candidates:
        prod_col = prod_candidates[0]
        print(f"\\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"AVERAGE UNIT PRICE BY {prod_col.upper()}")

        df['_unit_price'] = df[rev_col] / df[qty_col]

        for name, val in up.items():
            print(f"  {name}: ${val:,.2f}")

print(f"\\n{'='*60}")
print("END OF ANALYSIS")
print(f"{'='*60}")
